 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. San Francisco 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) did not practice Thursday, Nov. 12.
 SOURCE: 49ers.com 
 Why it Matters: Evans is set to miss at least another game while he recovers from an Achilles injury. He is worth stashing in the hopes that he can return before the end of the year, but in the meantime, George Kittle should remain busy.
